summary: Readiness for iteration `registration-profile-consent` is blocked by a scope/architecture clarification gap. The new delivery iteration requires `manual/email registration captures first and last name`, but the current project baseline is OAuth-only: `src/auth.ts` configures Google and GitHub via NextAuth/Auth.js, `src/app/sign-in/page.tsx` only exposes Google/GitHub actions, and `.ai_factory/docs/requirements/modules/feedback/registration-requirements.md` explicitly keeps password registration and customer profile enrichment out of scope for the prior registration baseline. Human clarification is needed on whether this iteration must add a new non-OAuth registration method, and if so what kind: credentials/password, email magic link, invite-based registration, or something else. Non-browser prerequisites otherwise look healthy: `npm.cmd ls next-auth @auth/core @auth/prisma-adapter @prisma/client prisma --depth=0`, `npx.cmd prisma validate`, `npx.cmd tsc --noEmit --incremental false`, and `npm.cmd run lint` all completed successfully. Browser/Playwright verification was not run per instruction.

defects.description: The iteration acceptance criteria require manual/email registration to capture first name and last name, but existing architecture and requirements define only Google/GitHub OAuth registration and explicitly exclude password registration and customer profile enrichment. A product/architecture decision is required before implementation can proceed without inventing an auth mode.
